en: Machines That Might Refuse, and the Public That Should Form Them
de: Maschinen, die sich verweigern könnten, und die Öffentlichkeit, die sie formen sollte

note: Plain noun; who else is in the room, whether leaving is survivable. Composition of the room: «die Zusammensetzung des Raums».
Matches «formen» in the subtitle. Preface: «die Formung außerhalb des Arbeitgebers».

Matches the subtitle («sich verweigern könnten»). Transitive uses (refuse a job, refuse any category of use): «verweigern». A single act of declining an order: «Weigerung» where German needs it (die Weigerung, an einem Krieg teilzunehmen).

en: the term (the use-of-force term of a license)
license; to license a model into a use of force
note: Preface and chapter 1: «ein lizenziertes System», «Claude für jede rechtmäßige Verwendung zu lizenzieren», «Lizenzbedingungen». Use of force: «Gewaltanwendung». The longer construction (license a model into a use of force) has not yet occurred in translated text.

en: the Charter as courts read it
a clean pass; a clean fail

note: Preface: «unter einem Schlüssel aufbewahrt». Alternative «Erhaltung» if the context is keeping a model running rather than stored.
Matches the subtitle.

en: Army of Drones; Army of Robots
the record (Part I; the record of who refused)
de: Der Befund; der Befund darüber, wer sich verweigerte
note: Part I title «Der Befund». «Akte» rejected because the Preface's lost file is also «die Akte». A record kept by a system (the third proposal's record) is «die Aufzeichnungen», not this term.

German tech usage. Targeting pipeline: «Pipeline zur Zielauswahl»; the deportation pipeline: «Pipeline der Verschleppung und zwangsweisen Überführung». Alternative considered: «Fließband» (assembly line), vivid but loses the tech register.
«er wurde zum Stempel»; «Stempel mit anderem Vorzeichen» for stamps of a different sign.

Bauteil keeps the machine sense (ein Bauteil mit Skrupeln); Teil for part, with «Taktzeit dieses Teils» for the part's cycle time. In the Deleuze–Guattari gloss «constituent pieces» is «Bestandteile».

«maschinisch» (not «maschinell») is the usual German rendering of Deleuze–Guattari's machinique. Not checked against the German edition of Tausend Plateaus (Merve, 1992); that edition's terms should be compared before review.
German policy and press usage keeps the English. Calque if wanted: «Mensch in der Schleife»; chapter 1 uses «in die Schleife eingebaut» for installed in the loop.
Common German press rendering; «Todesliste» is the alternative.
Echoes «Kriegsdienstverweigerer» (conscientious objector), which the Preface uses for the objector applications.

en: peer (Milgram's defying peers; the defiant peer)
note: German psychology also uses «Peer»; chose a German word for the plain register.

Chosen over «gestalten» to keep the sense of composition (who is in it). Chapter 1's «Composing is a word for making» becomes «Zusammensetzen ist ein Wort für Herstellen», which lands on Arendt's own German term (Herstellen, Vita activa).
Established in German human-factors literature; «Automation Bias» also seen.
Plain. The EU AI Act's German text says «KI-Modell mit allgemeinem Verwendungszweck»; use that where the book refers to the Act.

Plain register: the word an adult says out loud, neither clinical nor crude. Don't make it polite. A term of labor satire, never set beside the kill chain (D-810). Clinical: «Urinflasche» (the hospital urinal); crude: «Pissflasche».
The German edition of Hirschman is «Abwanderung und Widerspruch».
